query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN research_domain IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_domain,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_year
FROM bibliography_entries;
